text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm walking about the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Aaah! Out of my waaaay!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Thank goodness I didn't crash into
you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry to startle you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My fortune this morning said I'd have
good luck if
I gave my all to everything I
did today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm using my lucky dash to
get around,
and why I ate my lucky
lunch during class!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And when I got caught, I pulled out my
lucky
groveling to ask for forgiveness!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This overwhelming feeling of elation
must be the
sensation of my body
getting filled with good
fortune!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Urk! I swear I'm not being impatient! It's
more
than that!
choice_data_list: I feel like they're just in a rush...
Why not put a bit more spirit into it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm not, but... Nnngh... Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'll try to take things more
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'll start by holding this pen with so much
force
that it begins shaking...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...and activate every granule of my
fortune-telling
wisdom in order to fill my
upcoming quiz with
runes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her drive to give a hundred percent in
everything
is great, but I get the feeling
that she has extra
classes on the horizon.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's this?! Are you're saying I'm
still not
applying myself enthusiastically
enough?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Okay, then I'll warm myself up with some
crazy
mystical posing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to start doing it while I head
on over to
the training track.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Lemon peel, orange wheel, upside-down
purple
seal... One, two, threeee!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Gah! What the heck is she doing?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, the Colorful Seal Warm-Up
Routine
becomes an underground hit
among the
Umamusume.
